prompt: Who was the Argentinian president who resigned from the position the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated?
answer: The president was **General Pedro Pablo Ramírez**, who resigned as President of Argentina on **June 7, 1944**, the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium opened.
